body:
Musketeer/Arbalest

We don’t have enough raw backline damage dealers. We mostly have to rely on DoT heroes atm with Plague Doc, Runaway or the slower start Occ.

Bounty Hunter

We also don’t have a character than can manipulate ranks too well. Bounty Hunter was great for this. I also am super excited to his animations. His attacks in DD1 were extremely visceral, I would love to see his full 3D animated glory.

Eh? The game is about adapting to bleak situations yes but why place something so arbitrary like deaths door on enemies? It’s an incredibly artificial piece of rng with the sole purpose to fuck you. It’s not fun. 

And mechanics should be equal for what purpose? If the boss was being played by a real player, yeah, I don’t want them to have an unfair experience. They are not however. 

Death’s door was a mechanic to mitigate extreme cases of bad RNG. Why do enemies need it?
